stories.summary: Owner-only selection of the project's single LLM-scan AI model profile and high/medium/low tier, rendering it on project settings, refusing non-owners, profiles from another project, non-AI-model integrations and unknown tiers, and allowing the owner to clear the setting

Run the LLM audit stage in a sandbox that receives only the model key and model endpoint as environment, can reach only the model endpoint, mounts the exact requested bundle read-only, and records the model that produced the report alongside the scan and its located findings

Own the full security scan service and route that runs the static stage first and starts the LLM stage only when the static scan passed for the same skills commit and bundle, skipping the LLM stage on a static fail without calling the model, and refusing a commit with no packed bundle

Record an LLM scan that cannot run as unavailable with a specific reason for no project model, no model key, a rejected key, provider budget exhaustion and a scanner exiting without a report, and record a scan exceeding the fixed ten-minute limit as failed, never writing findings

Extend the author scan report for the LLM stage: show the model that ran the scan, the advisory banner, every finding's severity, rule, file and line, a clean no-findings state, the unavailable and failed reasons, and no static verdict, under the authoring gate only

Let a project member start a full static-then-LLM security scan from the skill page with the project's configured model profile and tier, creating no run, refusing non-members, disabling the control with no test project, and rejecting any per-scan model override

Prove a completed, unavailable or failed LLM scan leaves run start and the run's final verdict unchanged, that run start calls only the static scan route, and that no LLM finding or failure reason enters the run's verdict
